versions.changelog: v2.4.2 — Documentation-only: adds scenario D (just-installed welcome prompt). When the agent detects a fresh install with no applied-state stamp, it asks the user once whether to apply a logo now, optionally picking a random set from logos/ (excluding 'original'). Asks once, never re-prompts. No code change; relies entirely on the existing apply-logo.sh <set-name> flow.

v2.4.1 — Runtime state (applied-state stamp + logo-guard.log) moved out of the skill folder to ~/.openclaw/state/personalize-openclaw-webui-logo/; the published bundle is now leak-clean (no local paths or user names). check-and-restore.sh also gains the same Windows %APPDATA%/$USERPROFILE dist-discovery fallbacks that apply-logo.sh already had.

v2.4.0: Added optional gateway:startup auto-restore hook (logo-guard) that silently re-applies your logo whenever an openclaw upgrade overwrites dist/. apply-logo.sh now writes a .applied-state stamp. New: check-and-restore.sh, install-hook.sh, uninstall-hook.sh.
Fully English SKILL.md; remove Chinese trigger phrases (kept in skillhub edition).
Remove hardcoded user paths; auto-discover dist; cross-platform image toolchain.
v2.1.0: remove scenarios B(new set) and C(restore); keep A(apply set) and B(update library)
v2.0.1: 现有套列表去掉中文描述；更新场景D改走 clawhub update
5 logo sets (original/mac/windows/linux/mac-finder), apply-logo.sh switcher, update via hub. PNG masters stored as base64 .txt.
